info.title: Tlync Merchant API
info.summary: Payment orchestration for Libyan payment networks and wallets: discovery, two-stage direct payments, hosted checkout and merchant callbacks (api/v12).
info.description:
# Overview

This is the reference for the Tlync merchant API (`api/v12`). Tlync is a payment orchestration platform for Libya: a merchant integrates once and accepts payments from several Libyan payment networks and wallets (Edfali, Sadad, MobiCash, Yusor Pay, Musrefy Pay, Moamalat bank cards and, soon, Tadawul cards). Tlync talks to each provider, verifies the payment, records the order, computes the charges and credits the merchant's balance.

Every request and response in this reference is taken from the Tlync source code and its automated test suite (the **Tlync Merchant API Integration Guide**, 4 November 2026, is the long-form companion of this file).

## Environments

| Environment | API base URL | Hosted checkout page |
| --- | --- | --- |
| UAT (testing) | `https://devadmin.tlync.ly/api/v12` | `https://uat-chekout.next.com.ly` |
| Production | To be announced | To be announced (planned: `pay.tlync.ly`) |

All paths in this reference are relative to the API base URL.

## Two integration models

**Hosted checkout** (recommended for most web and mobile merchants): your server creates a checkout session (`POST /checkout/sessions`), sends the payer to the returned page URL, receives the `payment.success` callback and verifies the outcome with `GET /checkout/sessions/{session}`. The page handles gateway selection, the payer fields, OTP or PIN entry, resend, the Moamalat widget and retries.

**Direct API** (for merchants that own the payment form): discover the gateways with `GET /fetch/gateways`, then run the two-stage flow for the chosen gateway slug: `POST /initiate/payment/{slug}` (Tlync creates a temp order, contacts the provider, the payer receives a code) and `POST /complete/payment/{slug}` (Tlync confirms the code with the provider, creates the order and returns the receipt). Moamalat is the exception: the payer enters the card in Moamalat's LightBox widget and the complete call is a poll.

Both paths produce the same orders, the same callback and the same receipts.

## Authentication

* **Shop token** (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`): all server-to-server calls. The token is created in the merchant dashboard (shop, *API tokens* panel), is bound to one shop (`store_uuid`) and does not expire. Keep it on your server; never ship it in a browser or a mobile binary. 401 `Unauthenticated.` means no, malformed or revoked token; 403 `This action is unauthorized.` means the token cannot act for the shop or temp order named in the request.
* **Checkout key** (`X-Checkout-Key: cs_…`): the hosted checkout browser routes. The key is issued per session and travels in the fragment of the page URL (`#key=cs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCD`), so it never reaches a server log.
* **Signed URLs** (`expires` and `signature` query parameters): the Moamalat hosted page and its browser callbacks.

## Conventions

* HTTPS, JSON bodies, JSON answers. Send `Accept: application/json` so errors come back as JSON. Unknown body keys are ignored.
* **Money**: the only currency is LYD. `amount` in requests is a number with at most three decimals, at least `1` (`^\d+(\.\d{1,3})?$`); send it as a string (`"10.500"`) to avoid floating point surprises. Every amount in an answer is a **string with three decimals** (`"10.500"`, `"0.200"`). Parse them with a decimal type, never as floats.
* **Phone numbers**: Libyan mobiles only (`0912345678`, `218912345678`, `+218912345678`; the nine significant digits must start with 91, 92, 93, 94 or 95). Tlync normalises them to `218XXXXXXXXX`, which is the form returned as `customer_phone`.
* **Idempotency**: send `Idempotency-Key` as a header or `idempotency_key` in the body on every initiate and complete call (the header wins; on initiate `custom_ref` is used when neither is sent). Initiate: same key and same data returns the existing temp order (200); same key with different data is refused with 422 `تم استخدام مفتاح التكرار مسبقاً مع بيانات مختلفة`; a retry after a provider refusal re-runs the provider call on the same temp order. Complete: once an order exists, any further complete call for the same `transaction_id` returns the same receipt without contacting the provider, for three minutes; after that it answers 404.
* **`custom_ref`**: required on every initiate and checkout session, at most 255 characters, unique per shop (422 `The custom_ref has already been used for this shop.` on reuse).
* **Errors**: 422 with `errors` is a validation error (`{"message": "<first error>", "errors": {"<field>": ["…"]}}`); 422 without `errors` is a provider refusal, a wrong code or an idempotency conflict; 404 for not found or out of service; 409 for a state conflict or a still-pending Moamalat payment; 429 `Too Many Attempts.` with `Retry-After`; 503 for a server configuration problem. Provider messages are often in Arabic because they are shown to payers. Branch on the status and on the presence of `errors`, never on the text.
* **Rate limits** (per token): complete 6 per minute, Sadad resend 3 per minute, Tadawul lookup 30 per minute. Browser routes (per session and IP): 60 per minute, complete 5 per minute, resend 2 per minute.
* **Times**: `expires_at`, `paid_at`, `closed_at` are ISO 8601 with offset; `date` in receipts is `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` in the server's local time.
* **Identifiers**: `store_uuid`, `transaction_id`, `session_id` and `order_id` are UUIDs; `our_ref` is Tlync's opaque order reference (quote it to support).

## Gateways

| Slug | Payment method | Payer enters at initiate | Confirmation | Code length | Resend |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `test-gateway` | Test gateway (UAT only) | phone | `pin` | 4 | no |
| `edfali-gateway` | Edfali wallet | phone | `pin` | 4 | no |
| `sadad-gateway` | Sadad wallet | phone, birth year | `otp` | 6 | yes |
| `mobicash-gateway` | MobiCash card | card number | `otp` | 6 | no |
| `yusor-gateway` | Yusor Pay | national ID card (phone optional) | `otp` | 6 | no |
| `musrefy-gateway` | Musrefy Pay | national ID card (phone optional) | `otp` | 6 | no |
| `moamalat-gateway` | Bank cards via Moamalat LightBox | phone | `lightbox` | none | no |
| `tadawul-gateway` | Tadawul cards (UAT only, not yet in service) | phone + last 4 digits (lookup), then the chosen card | `otp` | 6 | no |

Which of these your shop can use is answered by `GET /fetch/gateways`.

## Changelog

### 1.3.0 (2026-11-04)

Rewritten from the November 2026 platform code and tests (branch `tlync-development` at `df33d22`, Tadawul from the UAT branch `proxy-auth`). Supersedes 1.2.0 (21 September 2026).

* **Servers**: UAT is `https://devadmin.tlync.ly/api/v12`; production is to be announced. The former `api.tlync.com`, `sandbox.tlync.com` and `checkout.tlync.com` hosts were removed.
* **Discovery**: `name` and `description` are `{en, ar_LY}` objects; `logo`, `confirmation`, `code_length`, `resend_available`, `fields[]` (objects with `type`, `required`, `label`), `charges`, `is_default`, `routes.resend`, plus `lightbox`, `platform` and `lookup` where relevant. `name_ar`, `logo_url`, `confirmation_type`, `required_fields`, `routes.resend_otp` and the `redirect` confirmation value are gone.
* **Money** in every answer is a string with three decimals; `customer_phone` is normalised to `218XXXXXXXXX`; the legacy shop `id` is a string.
* **Hosted checkout**: the page URL is `…/s/{session}#key=cs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCD` (key in the fragment); statuses are `open`, `pending`, `paid`, `failed`, `expired`, `cancelled`; default lifetime 30 minutes; templates `classic` and `minimal`; the verification document gained `gateway`, `transaction_id`, `order_id`, `paid_at`, `closed_at`, `order`, `redirect_url`, `last_error`, `attempts_left`, `amount_minor`, `current`. The browser routes (page, lookup, initiate, complete, resend, status, cancel) with the `X-Checkout-Key` header are documented again.
* **MobiCash**: `card_number` is required and `phone` optional; the code is an OTP (`otp`, alias `pin`); the session expires after 300 seconds (`expires_at`).
* **Moamalat**: the initiate answer carries `expires_at` and a nested `lightbox` object (`script_url`, `merchant_id`, `terminal_id`, `amount`, `merchant_reference`, `trx_date_time`, `secure_hash`, `complete_callback_url`, `error_callback_url`); the complete call is a poll that answers 409 while pending; `network_reference` is accepted on complete.
* **Tadawul**: new `POST /lookup/tadawul-gateway` (phone + `card_last4`), then `entity_code` and `card_expiry` at initiate; `card_pan` and `card_pin` are prohibited on UAT.
* **Sadad resend** answers `transaction_id` too and 409 once paid.
* **Errors**: no `code` field exists; complete errors are 403, 404, 409 or 422 (never 400); the reused `custom_ref` message is `The custom_ref has already been used for this shop.`.
* **Callback** (`payment.success`) documented as a webhook with its headers, retry policy (3 attempts, 1 minute then 5 minutes), private-address refusal, timeouts and the absence of a signature; the optional attempt webhook is documented too.
* **New**: rate limits, the three-minute replay window, idempotency conflicts and retries, simulator values per gateway, the error catalogue.

### 1.2.0 (2026-09-21)

Previous reference (removed the hosted checkout browser routes, theme changes).

post.description:
Moamalat is a card gateway with no code typed into your form: the payer enters the card in Moamalat's LightBox widget. `phone` required; `frontend_url` and `failed_front_end_url` recommended.

The answer (`next_step: lightbox`) carries `expires_at` (hosted page validity, 30 minutes), `url` (a signed Tlync-hosted page that loads the widget, for browsers and WebViews) and `lightbox`, the raw widget configuration for clients that embed Moamalat's script themselves. `lightbox.amount` is in dirhams.

**Simplest integration**: open `url` in the browser or a WebView. The page loads the widget, posts the result to the signed callback URLs and sends the payer to your `frontend_url` (or `failed_front_end_url`) exactly as given. Then confirm server-side with the complete poll.

**Embedding the widget yourself**: load `script_url`, pass `merchant_id`, `terminal_id`, `amount`, `merchant_reference`, `trx_date_time` and `secure_hash` to the LightBox as documented by Moamalat, and post the widget's completion and error payloads to `complete_callback_url` and `error_callback_url`.

**UAT simulator**: the hosted page shows *simulate success* and *simulate decline* buttons that drive the real callback route.

post.description:
Creates a hosted checkout session for the token's shop and returns the page URL to send the payer to. The page shows your shop name and logo, lists the gateways your shop offers, collects the payer fields and drives initiate, the OTP or PIN step, resend, the Moamalat widget and retries (3 payment attempts, 3 wrong codes per attempt). When the session ends the page sends the payer to `frontend_url` (paid) or `failed_front_end_url` (anything else), exactly as given.

The per-session key travels in the URL fragment (`#key=cs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCD`): browsers never send it to any server or log. Do not strip or rewrite the fragment, and do not log the URL.

Answers 201, or 200 when an idempotent replay returns an existing session. No Tlync-side rate limit.

post.description:
Posted to the `backend_url` of the payment the moment an order is created, whatever the path that completed it (your complete call, the hosted checkout, Moamalat's browser callback, or a reconciliation by Tlync staff). Never sent for failed, expired or cancelled payments. Delivered by a queue worker, so it arrives seconds after the complete answer, not before it. The body is exactly the complete receipt.

**Timeouts**: 5 seconds to connect, 15 seconds in total. Respond with any 2xx status as fast as possible and process afterwards.

**Retries**: any non-2xx status, timeout or connection error counts as a failed delivery. Tlync retries one minute after the first failure, then five minutes after the second (three attempts in total). After the last failure the order is marked `permanently_failed` for webhook delivery on Tlync's side; the order stays paid. Every attempt, its payload, the response status and body are logged for support.

**Restrictions on `backend_url`**: a valid absolute URL of at most 2048 characters, reachable over HTTPS. Hostnames resolving to localhost, a private range (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16) or a reserved range are refused without retry. Tlync publishes no fixed source IP.

**Verification**: the callback is not signed. Look the payment up by `data.custom_ref`; check `data.amount` and `data.store_id`; for the hosted checkout call `GET /checkout/sessions/{session}` and act only when `session.status` is `paid` and `session.order.our_ref` matches; for the direct API reject callbacks whose `our_ref` conflicts with the one you stored. Make processing idempotent on `custom_ref` or the `Idempotency-Key` header, and protect the endpoint with an unguessable path or a secret query parameter.

If you send `attempt_webhook` on initiate or on a checkout session, Tlync posts the temp order record to it every time a temp order is created for that payment (including the hosted checkout's retries), before any confirmation. code.description: The OTP or PIN typed by the payer. Absent for Moamalat (server-side verification).

CheckoutCompleteFailedResponse.description: A wrong code. `status` stays `pending` while wrong codes remain, `failed` (with the failure `redirect_url`) when the budget is exhausted.

examples: No payment is waiting for confirmation

allOf.description: Plus the current state of the session (the paid answer when already paid, the status document otherwise).

examples: Payment is still pending at Moamalat

MoamalatCallbackCompleteRequest.description: The LightBox completion payload as the widget emits it (JSON or form-encoded). Tlync verifies `SecureHash` over the scalar fields (minus `SecureHash`, `CardToken`, `CustomerId`), or asks Moamalat when it does not match, then checks the amount and creates the order.

MoamalatCallbackErrorRequest.description: The LightBox error payload. The message is read from `error`, `ErrorMessage`, `Message` or `message` (first present), `Payment failed` otherwise. Before failing, Tlync asks Moamalat whether the payment was approved after all.

custom_ref.description: Present when the payment is completed.

callback_url.description: The signed complete or error callback URL to post `payload` to.

payload.description: A signed completion or error payload (`SecureHash` included).

errors.description: Messages per field (dotted keys for nested fields such as `customer.phone`).

AttemptWebhookPayload.description: The temp order record. Unlike every other answer, `value` and `value_base` are the amount in dirhams as an integer.

order_method.description: `{slug}.api` for the direct API, `{slug}.checkout` for the hosted page.

order_content.description: Your initiate payload (or the one the hosted page built).

Unauthenticated.description: No token, a malformed header, or a revoked token.
